login.title: Login
login.passwordReset: Password changed. Log in with your new password.
login.codeSent: We emailed a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.

register.title: Register (farmers only)
register.staffNote: Grader and admin accounts are created by the system administrator.
register.errPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the email you registered with and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.expiry: The link expires in 30 minutes. Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.incomplete: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again, or ask for a new one.
reset.errShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How to use MaziwaTrack for each role
help.farmer2: Click Record delivery and enter the litres.
help.farmer4: Check status; open the receipt once Paid.
help.grader2: Select a batch, enter measured litres.
help.grader3: Choose Pass or Reject and save.
help.admin2: Approve payment; the farmer is emailed.
help.admin3: Use Reports and Audit log from the menu.

farmer.title: My deliveries
farmer.giveNumber: Give this number to the grader with your milk.
farmer.empty: No deliveries yet. Record your first delivery.
farmer.errLitres: Litres must be a number greater than 0

grader.title: Batches to test
grader.noneWaiting: No batches waiting to be tested.
grader.selectPrompt: Select a batch from the list to test it.
grader.mismatch: Measured litres ({{measured}} L) differ from declared litres ({{declared}} L). The admin will see this batch flagged.
grader.errMeasured: Measured litres must be a number greater than 0

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.footnote: Mismatched batches are highlighted. Use the status filter to browse Recorded, Rejected and Paid batches.
approvals.mismatchWarn: Litres differ from the declared amount ({{declared}} L). Payment is on measured litres.
approvals.emailFailed: Email could not be sent; please inform the farmer.
approvals.resent: Receipt for {{number}} sent to the farmer.

reports.title: Reports
reports.previewHint: Choose a report and dates, then click Generate report to see a preview.
reports.noteMismatch: Batches where the litres measured by the grader differ from what the farmer declared. Difference = measured minus declared.
reports.noteLitres: Litres are measured litres where the batch has been tested, otherwise declared litres.
reports.errFarmer: Enter a farmer name for a farmer statement.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.none: No audit entries match these filters.
audit.readOnly: Read only: audit entries cannot be edited or deleted.
